why: Deleting a group that is gone answers 404, which the Admin REST API document (keycloak.org/docs-api/26.8.1/rest-api/openapi.json) leaves out: it declares only 204 for this operation.
Deleting a user that is gone answers 404, which the Admin REST API document (keycloak.org/docs-api/26.8.1/rest-api/openapi.json) leaves out: it declares only 204, 400, 403 for this operation.

Keycloak's person-name validator refuses characters the document permits: POST /admin/realms/{realm}/users with the "metacharacter" seed variant answers 400 {"field":"firstName","errorMessage":"error-person-name-invalid-character","params":["firstName"]}, though UserRepresentation.firstName is a plain string. The document should state the constraint.
